plugin.mssql.description: Microsoft SQL Server 2017 or later and Azure SQL Database.
plugin.mssql.name: SQL Server
plugin.mssql.tls_mode.help: require encrypts without checking the certificate. verify-full also checks the certificate and host name; strict uses TDS 8 and is required by some Azure setups.
plugin.mssql.user.help: SQL Server cannot keep a query read-only by itself: use a login that is only a member of db_datareader. Rowbird never needs to write.
